semantic.justification: Existing bounded STORE/ZIP32 package output now emits admitted LOC/CEN/END field order through real ByteChucker, Sequence, UNOMemoryStream, native ZipEntry aggregate and SAL counted Unicode-to-OString ownership. The original aggregate scalar fields stay indeterminate until initialized; copy/move/assignment/destruction retain actual OUString member ownership. Original OString Unicode conversion constructor and internal OUStringToOString view helper delegate to the genuine C converter and preserve counted embedded zero. The old per-field DataView writer is removed; public flat bytes/putNextEntry/finish, deterministic caller timestamp, duplicate/count/size admission, ZIP32-only and no-recovery policies remain explicit. Header-only transport is not full ZipOutputStream constructor/threadpool/deflate/encryption/ZIP64/package/storage/model/filter/UI parity. Primitive allocator/pointer/ABI/thread guarantees remain unverified. Invalid fake private-entry/byte test values were removed; independent golden bytes, actual65535 public entries, value ownership and real package reopen cover this checkpoint.
